figurative_meaning_bn: গভীর জল; এত জল যে সাঁতরে পার হতে হয়
figurative_meaning_en: Deep water; water so much that one has to swim to cross it
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই নদীতে সাঁতার জল, সতর্ক থেকো।
বিষয়টি সাঁতার জল, সহজে বোঝা যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: This river has swimming water, be careful.
The topic is deep water, not easy to understand.
note: Often used to describe situations requiring skill or effort, reflecting rural water-crossing experiences in Bengal.
